edits.why: maude-v2 scopes its tokens to .maude-v2/.ds[data-theme]; its .callout rule needs a .ds ancestor. Theme stays dark (see notes).
Artboard 'compare': maude-v2 has no .panel; floating chrome is .island.
Artboard 'compare' close button: maude-v2's icon button is .icon-btn; .btn--icon doesn't exist.

notes: .island is frosted (backdrop blur over --island-bg) where .panel was a solid surface. The diff sheets sit over a dimmed shell, so check the result reads as one solid sheet; if not, give .dv-sheet a solid background in DiffView.css.
The conflict intro callout (.callout--info) keeps its class. maude-v2's .callout has no tone variants, so it renders as a quiet neutral callout. Accept, or add a local tone.
The before/after rings use --status-warn / --status-success. Both exist in maude-v2 with new values, so the rings re-tint but keep their meaning.
Theme: kept data-theme="dark". maude-v2 is light-first; switching is one word in the wrapper.

Words: the canvas says 'Last published / Your version'. maude-v2 says 'Share' instead of publish (CONTRACT §3), and the collaborator 'Anna' would be Tereza or Jonas (§4). The brief calls the vocabulary load-bearing, so copy is not changed here.
The inline Maude mark is the v1 shape; maude-v2's mark lives in system/maude-v2/preview/logo. Not redrawn here.
